ef45dda.subject: fix: remediate deep-audit critical/high findings (graders, leakage, boundary)
ef45dda.message:
fix: remediate deep-audit critical/high findings (graders, leakage, boundary)

Graders (real_trace_experiments.py): extract_numeric_candidate now takes the
last numeric token by position (no fraction-before-int); extract_word_fraction
requires an explicit numerator (no bare-ordinal fractions); _strip_latex_math
only peels a single-variable assignment (no "0" for a plane); balanced-brace
\boxed{} extractor; MATH loader fails hard instead of silently swapping corpora.
Regression tests in research/tests/test_graders.py (18/18).

Analysis (trace_analysis.py): out-of-sample evaluation via GroupKFold-by-run_id
for the probe + all learned detectors + threshold/EB/e-process selection (kills
the in-sample leakage); first_zero_crossing implements inf{t>=2: mu<=0}; oracle
floored at t>=2; alpha/beta fit on genuine t>=2 transitions; pooled_proxy_drift
= prf-pcf-lambda; EB ddof=0 and delta_t ~ step^2. cross_family uses pooled OOF.

Orchestration: collection_complete is scope-aware (smoke leftover can't pass as
a full cell); atomic manifest write; smoke routed to a _smoke tree; model_offload
gitignored. regrade_traces.py recomputes labels from stored answers (GPU-free).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

6f832ea.subject: fix: correct canonical boundary operator + regenerate all results out-of-sample
6f832ea.message:
fix: correct canonical boundary operator + regenerate all results out-of-sample

generate_thesis_artifacts.first_zero_crossing (imported by cross_family) and
frontier_validation_report.first_zero_crossing had the same defect as the
trace_analysis copy: no t>=2 floor + step-1 fallback -> theory-forbidden step-1
boundaries. Now T* = inf{t>=2: drift<=0}, None if never observed.

Regenerated every cell (re-graded labels + out-of-sample analysis) and the
cross-family report. Net effect of the full remediation:
- boundaries: theory-forbidden step-1s gone (weak models now 2); late witnesses
  unchanged (Qwen 7/14/32 = 5); capability ladder and cross-family conclusion intact.
- probe AUC now honest out-of-fold: max 0.91 (Qwen-14B) vs inflated in-sample 0.96;
  most models 0.65-0.75.
- 545/165000 labels corrected by the re-grade.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

8beba2d.subject: fix(grader): credit prose/unit-wrapped numeric MATH answers
8beba2d.message:
fix(grader): credit prose/unit-wrapped numeric MATH answers

Validation on a 25-problem Qwen-7B MATH run surfaced false negatives where the
model gave the right number wrapped in words/units ("Savings: 550 gallons",
"1.25 miles") -> marked wrong. math_answers_equivalent now compares the
candidate's trailing numeric token by value when the gold answer is numeric,
guarded so it never number-grabs from symbolic answers (=, ^, \, or digit-letter
adjacency like 5r) -> "5x-7y+11z+4=0" is not reduced to "0". Tests 23/23.

0ea16f4.subject: audit: scientific-rigor verification + full loss autopsy (rigor_audit/)
0ea16f4.message:
audit: scientific-rigor verification + full loss autopsy (rigor_audit/)

Six-module audit of the overthinking-boundary results. Headline (74,540
runs; 89.59/2.83/7.57 W/T/L) reproduces run-for-run via an independent
code path and is label-robust: real regrade drift is 1 row in 798,770 --
the 1.62% dry-run figure (074bc70) was regrade-tool artifacts; running
that tool for real would corrupt ~12,284 ARC/GPQA labels (patch first).
All three prior numeric contradictions closed with named causes. New
defects found: qwen2p5_7b__math detector stage covers 75/1500 runs
(repair protocol pre-registered); 50.9% oracle-capture rests on a
hardcoded 12-cell selection (honest all-cells: 63.66%); GSM8K/MATH
loss-concentration narrative refuted (GPQA outranks MATH). Losses
exhaustively classified (B196/C459/D599/E1652/F2740, sums to 5,646) by
the committed re-runnable research/classify_losses.py; ranked levers and
pre-registered protocols P1-P13 in ThesisDocs/rigor_audit/.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

d2a42e8.subject: research: P3b/P3c/P3d offline policy arm results (one survivor: P3d)
d2a42e8.message:
research: P3b/P3c/P3d offline policy arm results (one survivor: P3d)

Census harness research/offline_policy_arms_p3.py replicates the production
GroupKFold-by-run_id scoring exactly (recomputed hazard_drift stops match
detector_comparison_by_run.csv for 75,965/75,965 runs, 0 mismatches), then
swaps only the stop rule per pre-registered arm:
- P3b churn-gated hysteresis: FAILED (net dU -1,004; 683 E-losses dissolve
  but 191 win->loss + delay on 15,922 moved stops dominate).
- P3c best-so-far selection: FAILED (16/180 C-losses dissolved, 132
  win->loss; diagnostic AUC 0.824 does not yield selection precision).
  Step-1-inclusive sub-arm also negative (-171).
- P3d per-cell drift-threshold calibration (fit on GroupKFold-by-task_id
  train folds, evaluated OOF): PASSED, +1,545.85 net utility (~44% of the
  3,543-utility loss mass); fitted offsets mean +0.08 (stop sooner).
  Caveat recorded: utility-optimal but loss COUNT rises (~5,735 -> ~6,086)
  -- report utility and win-rate together.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

1f2e445.subject: research: P9 lambda-sensitivity results
1f2e445.message:
research: P9 lambda-sensitivity results

Exact analytic sweep (research/lambda_sensitivity_sweep.py): fitted models
are lambda-independent, so mu_lambda <= 0 iff (1-q)a - q*b <= lambda; the
recovered out-of-fold base series gives the exact sweep with lambda in both
the rule and the utility. Validation: lambda=0.05 reproduces the recorded
stops and 68,095/2,135/5,735 exactly (0 mismatches, 75,965 runs).
Result: PASSED - win rate 87.65/88.84/89.64/90.86/98.78% at lambda
0.01/0.02/0.05/0.10/0.20; max in-band deviation 1.26pp vs the +-5pp bar.
Headline is not knife-edged on the lambda=0.05 convention; lambda=0.2 is a
degenerate stop-everything regime, flagged as such. (The heavyweight
out-of-place re-run approach was abandoned at 19/208 cells for runtime.)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

cca2113.subject: research: calibrated per-cell threshold table (P3d productization)
cca2113.message:
research: calibrated per-cell threshold table (P3d productization)

Generator research/calibrate_cell_thresholds.py + table at
_aggregate/calibrated_cell_thresholds.csv (52 cells). Validation: 0 stop
mismatches across all runs; sum of per-cell OOF gains = +1,545.85,
matching the committed P3d census exactly. Leakage recipe documented:
quote oof_dU (GroupKFold-by-task_id, held-out), deploy delta_full_DEPLOY
(full-cell refit), never cite cal_full_* in-sample companions as gains.
Findings (rigor_audit/06): delta mean +0.080 -- the uncalibrated policy
over-thinks on 45/52 cells; the 7 negative-delta cells (want MORE
patience) are almost exactly the known late-boundary cells, i.e. the
calibration independently rediscovers the overthinking-boundary
structure. mistral_small_24b_2409__gsm8k (worst cell, 30.27% loss)
improves on BOTH metrics (loss -> 14.00%, +122.65 utility). Framing
caveat recorded: corpus-level calibration is utility-optimal, not
win-rate-optimal (losses 5,735 -> 6,191; supersedes the earlier ~6,086
approximation in rigor_audit/05).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

36a13c9.subject: docs: pre-registered algorithm-v2 protocols (N1-N9)
36a13c9.message:
docs: pre-registered algorithm-v2 protocols (N1-N9)

Next-step experimental design grounded in the offline campaign's
verdicts: per-run guards/selectors are exhausted (P1/P3a/P3b/P3c all
failed census), so improvement comes from (1) context-conditioning --
does P3d calibration transfer? (N1 meta-calibration LOCO, N4 two-
parameter task modulation), (2) belief-state quality on existing
features (N2 probe suite, N3 hierarchical hazards -- all CPU), and
(3) enriching the filtration with new observables, the only legitimate
way to raise the online bound (N7 k=2 self-consistency agreement with
token-cost-charged utility, N8 answer-span logprob + pooled mid-layer
recorder pilots -- GPU + engineering). Tier 2 = the already-registered
GPU items P4b/P8. Standard OOF metrics fixed (net dU, oracle capture,
boundary error P(|err|<=1), W/L/T with tie caveat).

legacy_report_limitations.finding: Builds each sequence from a complete trajectory and its final correctness, then broadcasts that trajectory score to all step rows before hybrid fitting. This stored hybrid comparison is retrospective, not a prefix-time stopping demonstration.

Its Markdown overall-AUC95% interval is rendered as auc_hybrid +/-0.004, rather than a computed interval. Its separately stored bootstrap lift interval is actually computed. Do not promote the fixed-window row to statistical evidence.

Multi-Seed/1000-bootstrap terminology denotes task resampling using one RNG seed and fold-specific model seeds, not independent repeated generation experiments. Current thesis already states this distinction.

Old late-repair linear-probe limitations and projected recoverability are not an information-theoretic impossibility theorem. Current failure audit excludes embedded old probe tags, and Chapter4 explicitly rejects that inference.

current_narrow_thesis_decision.rationale: Existing data support protocol-specific empirical contrasts, observed repair/corruption, failure taxonomy, held-out retrospective/replay diagnostics and actual implemented stopping with explicitly low accuracy/fixed-two equivalence. The mathematical results are conditional formal results; no empirical proof of universal optimum, calibrated live conditional hazards or broad no-loss savings is claimed.
current_narrow_thesis_decision.original_contribution_case: Application and assumption audit of established mathematics, matched estimator/generation contrasts, documented negative findings, and a reproducible causal selected-answer runtime/evidence protocol. This is an evidence-backed applied contribution case, not a certified new general theorem or guarantee of faculty acceptance.
stronger_optional_claims_requiring_furth: adaptive utility advantage over a fixed budget
prespecified accuracy noninferiority across independent tasks/seeds
semantic correctness labels adjudicated at scale
universal accuracy peak or architecture-independent savings
current_narrow_thesis_decision.scope_rule: Unproved stronger claims and proposed P7/continuation/seed studies are not automatically mandatory JHU tasks for this narrower thesis.

current_working_vs_GitHub: The v3 formal chapter revisions, compiled sources/PDFs and v3 review receipts are current local working-tree artifacts; HEAD/GitHub remains6e4378be. Historical committed science is distinguished from current uncommitted formal presentation.
